resources.string: Check GitHub, download the newest version, verify it and open the Android installer
Off by default. At most once every 6 hours, only github.com is contacted, no personal data is sent.
Stable follows finished releases. Preview also follows work-in-progress builds.
Show older builds and reinstall help
Android refuses to install an older build over a newer one. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases saved data. Nothing is ever uninstalled automatically.
The Android installer is open. Confirm there to finish updating.
Android needs your OK before GameSuite can open an update. Tap Open settings, switch on Allow from this source, then come back. You only do this once.
Update checks contact github.com only. No account, token or personal data is used. This section exists only in sideload builds, not in the Play Store version.
No connection to GitHub. Check your internet and try again.
GitHub is limiting requests for a while. Try again later.
GitHub answered with an error (%1$d). Try again later.
The update pointed somewhere that is not allowed, so it was refused.
Too many redirects, so the download was refused.
GitHub sent something unexpected, so it was ignored.
The file is larger than the safe limit, so it was refused.
This release has no checksum to verify against, so it was not installed.
The download does not match its checksum, so it was deleted.
This release has no installable app file.
Not enough free storage to download the update.
The downloaded file could not be read as an app, so it was deleted.
The downloaded file is a different app, so it was deleted.
The downloaded build is not newer than the installed one. Android blocks going back to an older build; it would need an uninstall first, which erases saved data.

This build was signed with a different key than the installed app, so Android cannot update it in place. Nothing was changed. To switch, you would have to uninstall GameSuite (which erases saved data) and install the new build. See docs/release/SIDELOAD-UPDATES.md.
No installer could be opened on this device.
